_comment: A vendor's own benchmark is charted against that vendor's best PUBLISHED setup for it (user ruling 2026-09-29). Each entry names the setup, its source and pinned commit, the chart row it becomes and the panel caption. Kept out of ../chart-configs.json, whose bytes are pinned by comparison.json and backends.PINNED_SHA256. The tuned tool's own entity names map to canonical labels through `extra_labels` on top of the comparison's `presidio` table; they drive only the typed metrics, never leaked or false-positive bytes.

presidio-research.caption: Presidio tuned for this dataset by its authors (their published custom setup)
presidio-research.setup: notebook 5, custom analyzer: OpenMed NER recognizer, title/year/age pattern recognizers, lemma context enhancement, 14 predefined recognizers removed, score threshold 0.3
